title: Oracle C2M SSO, SSL & Certificate/Keystore Configuration
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Oracle Utilities C2M + WebLogic 14c administration; middleware/database/integration work, production-impact care).

Oracle Utilities C2M/CC&B/MDM + WebLogic 14c authored from Oracle's official product + OUAF docs; version-specific details (C2M 25.4/min v2.9, WebLogic 14c) cited or flagged 'verify for your version'; My-Oracle-Support-gated patches/notes are pointed to, not reproduced. Automation is WLST (Jython)/shell/SQL, not PowerShell.
hook: Secure C2M end to end: SSO, SSL, and keystores
problem: C2M and WebLogic have to be secured properly — Single Sign-On, SSL/TLS, and the certificate keystores underneath — or you get broken logins, untrusted endpoints, and audit findings. This solution configures the C2M security plumbing: SSO integration, SSL/TLS on the WebLogic domain and C2M, and identity/trust keystore setup and management, pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the C2M security model: SSO, SSL/TLS termination, and the identity/trust keystore chain on WebLogic.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (IdP for SSO, certificates/CA, WebLogic domain, C2M config).

Implementation Guide — exact steps to configure SSO, enable SSL/TLS on the domain and C2M, create/manage identity and trust keystores, wire certificates, and validate secure sign-in and endpoints, pilot-first.

5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (SSO works, SSL valid, keystores trusted) plus Best Practices for certificate lifecycle and key rotation.
short: Configure the C2M security plumbing — SSO, SSL/TLS on WebLogic and C2M, and identity/trust keystores — so sign-in, endpoints, and trust are correct, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
